_brief: Item 13 TO EDIT, variation 2 - the one that BREATHES (~50s): five different people from variation 1, longer answers. Opens on the question and the tefillin-app answer, the deepest answer (man in the black tank top: pain as an opportunity for growth) 4th, ends on the woman listing her whole family in Israel - 'what is better than that?'. Hebrew line (the artist, Supreme Court) read by two models. NO ZOOMS (LESSONS 80).
beats: HOOK: the question once ('what's your good news?') and the young man with a kippah: 'I made a tefillin app ... 600 people wrapping tefillin now' - host 'congrats brother'
two young women: 'we did our Aliyah this year alone' - 'from France?' - 'Paris'
older man (Hebrew): 'I'm going to present my artwork at the Supreme Court this Monday' - host 'wow'
STRONGEST: man in the black tank top: 'learning to not see pain as a roadblock but as an opportunity for growth ... showing up to life a lot happier now'
ENDING, woman in the white cap, arms open: 'I'm in Eretz Yisrael with my beautiful family ... and their three-and-a-half-month-old baby. What is better than that?'
